about: One camp, as /en/studio is one studio: the hexagonal pop-up tent from the 2026-10-25 footage (public/footage/IMG_3172) pitched on a low timber deck, furnished for two. The 2D (camp-plan.tsx) and the 3D (scripts/site/render/camp.html) both read this file; the hero is the Nano Banana render of the same camp. Plan in metres: x to the right, y toward the front (the door), the tent's centre at 0,0. Sizes past the tent are design choices, not yet sourced.

tent.about: Hexagonal pop-up, flat sides front and back, door on the front side. 2.8 m across the corners (a 5-8 person model; today's tents look about 2.5 m), walls standing to the shoulder, hips up to a small six-sided top.

deck.about: Eucalyptus boards on bearers, a hexagon in line with the tent, set forward so a porch opens in front of the door.

bed.about: A small double mattress on a low slatted base against the back wall, white bedding, two pillows, a mustard throw at the foot.

crate.about: Bedside: a timber crate with a lantern.

porch.about: On the deck in front of the door: two folding timber chairs either side of a small round table with a lantern.
